_comment: Shared size-detail specimens (§10.2): the same accepted and refused details run through `detail` and `conflict_detail` in both validators — the v7 schema's real `inferred_size` references (Rust twin) and the command-line checker (Python twin). Every `refused` specimen is refused by both validators in both slots; every `valid` specimen validates in both slots. Numeric spellings stay integer tokens: float spellings are a separate deliberate checker/schema divergence, pinned beside the twins, never in this table.
